data.name: Chastity
data.gender_notes: Chastity is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word castus, meaning pure, chaste, and innocent. The name Chastity was popular in the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, and it was often given to girls to encourage virtue and moral purity. The name Chastity carries the meaning “Purity, Innocence, Chasteness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chastity usually hope their child will grow to embody purity, innocence, chasteness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a commitment to moral purity and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Chastity belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Purity, Innocence, Chasteness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chastity total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קסטות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קסטות נגזר מהמילה האנגלית 'Chastity' שפירושה טוהר וצדק. הוא קשור למוסר ולטוהר המוסרי, ומשמש כזכרון לטוהר ולצדק המוסריים. השם משקף ערכים של שלמות וטוהר.

in_greek.name: Χαστίτι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χαστίτι προέρχεται από την αγγλική λέξη 'Chastity', που σημαίνει καθαρότητα και σεμνότητα. Σχετίζεται με την ηθική και την πνευματική καθαρότητα, και χρησιμοποιείται ως υπενθύμιση για την ηθική και πνευματική τελειότητα.

in_latin.name: Chastitas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Chastitas derivatum est ex voce Anglica 'Chastity', quae significat pudicitia et castitas. Refertur ad castitatem morum et puritatem spiritualem, et admonet ad vitam virtutibus et castitate plenam.

in_english.name: Chastity
in_english.meaning: Purity of heart and moral integrity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Chastity originates from the Latin 'castitas', meaning purity and chastity. It is associated with moral integrity, purity of heart, and spiritual cleanliness. In Christian tradition, Chastity is considered one of the three theological virtues, along with Faith and Charity. The name symbolizes modesty, self-control, and devotion to God. Historically, it has been used to signify a life of virtue and moral excellence. Today, the name Chastity is used across various Christian cultures to signify a commitment to spiritual purity and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: Chastity as a name carries a rich cultural heritage, representing a time when virtues such as purity, modesty, and morality held great importance in society. The name Chastity was often given to young girls to inspire them to live pure and virtuous lives. It emphasized the importance of self-control and abstaining from sexual sins, and was seen as a mark of honor and respectability.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Chastity is a virtue that reflects the Christian belief in self-control and living a life in accordance with God's laws. It is a symbol of the purity of heart and soul, and a reminder of the importance of living in a way that pleases God. By embracing the virtue of Chastity, we are able to resist the temptations of the world and focus on our spiritual growth, drawing closer to God.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
